rationales.deterministic-orchestration-v2: form (c) + (a). The contributed SGCR system is a fixed code pipeline whose stages each call a model for one bounded job, with code — not a model — controlling the outermost flow. Explicit path: source code C + specs S are dispatched to n independent LLM reviewer instances {M1..Mn} (bounded task: review against specs → Ri), then an aggregator LLM Magg is called to merge them → Rexplicit; long specs are code-chunked ('dynamic specification segmentation strategy based on a divide-and-conquer approach') and each chunk run in parallel then synthesized. Implicit path runs a fixed propose→retrieve→verify sequence: a proposer LLM Mproposer produces Qhypo (bounded: propose issues), then a DETERMINISTIC retrieval step the code owns — embed each q, similarity-search a pre-indexed vector DB → Sretrieved(q) — feeds a verifier LLM ensemble {Mverify,1..n} (bounded: confirm each q is valid). The two pathway outputs Rexplicit and Rimplicit are then fed to a final aggregation process that de-duplicates, prioritizes by severity inferred from spec metadata, and consolidates → Rfinal. No model ever decides what step runs next: the models are components (reviewers, aggregator, proposer, verifiers, optional code generator), and the harness advances the state through the fixed explicit/implicit/final stages — form (a) sequencing, with code also performing the retrieval routing that each verifier receives — form (c) dispatch. Preconditions met: orchestrator is code (no LLM planner), models perform steps, and the control sits at the system's outermost level. Built and evaluated in a live production environment (279 cases, ablation study), so not a census case.
